heading: Built for the business, not for a CMS.
subtext: Most web options for trade businesses are either cheap templates that look it, or heavy WordPress builds that need constant care. There's a better middle.

cards.title: Simple by design
cards.body: A focused website with the pages homeowners actually want — services / trades, crew, licensed-and-insured trust signals, service area, and an easy way to request an estimate. No bloat.

cards.title: Fast to launch
cards.body: Most sites go live in about two weeks. Send us your license info, services, and a few jobsite photos, and we handle the rest — you don't need to learn a builder.

cards.title: Zero maintenance
cards.body: No plugins to update, no PHP versions to chase, no security patches to worry about. Hosting, SSL, backups, and uptime are all handled — and there's no CMS attack surface.

cards.title: Built on solid systems
cards.body: Static-site architecture, edge caching, and managed hosting mean your site loads fast and stays up — even when a storm hits and the phones start ringing.
